title: Positive-degree injective module hypercover section acyclicity
statement: for every positive p, the module alternating coface section homology object is zero

proof.text: Apply Hom into I to the positive-degree free R-module components. The module Yoneda identification identifies the dual with the alternating coface section complex, and injectivity forces all positive homology objects to vanish.

lean.statement:
theorem hypercover_injective_module_positive
    {X : Scheme.{w}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : SplitEtaleHypercover X) (R : Type (w + 1)) [CommRing R]
    (I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{w + 1} R)) [Injective I] :
    ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → IsZero
      (((AlgebraicTopology.alternatingCofaceMapComplex (ModuleCat.{w + 1} R)).obj
          (U.simplicial.rightOp ⋙ I.obj)).homology p)
